title: Displays and night light
description: Resolution, scale, arrangement and color temperature.

sections.title: Displays
sections.description: Arrange your displays; each change is tried for 15 s and undone unless you keep it.

sections.title: Night light
sections.description: Warmer screen colors with less blue light, by hand from the right sidebar or on a schedule.

sections.title: Bright flash protection
sections.description: Protects your eyes from sudden white screens while you use dark mode.

entries.label: Display layout file edited by hand
entries.description: Layout changes are not saved to ~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua until you replace it; a backup is made first.

entries.label: Quick layouts
entries.description: Extend the desktop, duplicate it or use a single display.

entries.label: Connected displays
entries.description: Turn each display on or off and choose its resolution, scale, rotation and position.
entries.help: Displays that support it also offer variable refresh rate (FreeSync/G-Sync).

entries.label: Automatic night light
entries.description: Turns the night light on and off every day at the set times.
entries.help: You can still switch it by hand with the night light button in the right sidebar (Super+N).

entries.label: Turn on at
entries.description: Start of the night light period, in 24-hour time; it may end the next day.

entries.label: Turn off at
entries.description: End of the period; a time earlier than the start means the next morning.

entries.label: Color temperature
entries.description: Lower values look more orange: 6500 K is like daylight, around 4000 K is a usual night value.

entries.label: Dim bright windows
entries.description: Only in dark mode: after each window or workspace change it checks the screen and dims it if it is bright.
entries.help: It takes a screenshot to measure the brightness and changes the real brightness of the display.
